usage: A common loanword used for the small four-string instrument; it is a normal everyday noun in Hong Kong Cantonese.
Often used with verbs like 彈 and learners may hear it in music lessons, performance talk, and hobby contexts.
The full form 烏克麗麗 is more formal/explicit; many speakers also simply say 𠸎? No, avoid unsupported. Stick to the given word in writing.
This word is usually neutral in register and can refer to the instrument itself, not just the playing style.
